note: Reviewed inputs to sbom.mjs beyond Chromium's own licence metadata. blancAssets: third-party files the Island serves from the beta's resources; each file's SHA-256 must equal chromium/blanc/island-assets.json, and its name, version, licence and text come from compliance/policy.json, and unless it is marked derived (built from the reviewed source) it must be byte-identical to that asset's file. chromiumAdditions: components inside folders Chromium's licenses.py skips for missing metadata (upstream Chrome's credits skip them too); paths are relative to Chromium src. reviewedSkips: every folder licenses.py skips must be listed here or under chromiumAdditions, or the audit fails. notBundled: third-party payloads deliberately absent from the packaged beta, so they are not in the SBOM.

reviewedSkips.third_party/rust: A container: each crate under third_party/rust/chromium_crates_io carries its own metadata and is listed individually.
reviewedSkips.third_party/perfetto/protos/third_party/: Perfetto's own protocol definitions, covered by the Perfetto component and its licence.
